objective: Rank N-1 branch outage contingencies by operational severity and flag outages that island the network.

ranking: ordered contingency IDs from most severe to least severe

hard_constraints: All critical contingencies causing overload or islanding must appear in the ranking.
Islanding contingencies must be flagged true in islanding_flags.

metrics.name: feasible
metrics.description: Whether all critical and islanding contingencies are captured without invalid IDs.

metrics.name: missed_critical_contingencies
metrics.description: Critical N-1 outages omitted from the submitted ranking.

metrics.name: missed_islanding
metrics.description: Islanding outages not flagged by the submission.

metrics.name: score
metrics.description: Normalized [0,1] score: 1 minus scaled ranking penalties if feasible, else 0.

source_evidence: Graph Computing based Fast Screening in Contingency Analysis (arXiv:1904.00044v1)
Fast Grid Splitting Detection for N-1 Contingency Analysis by Graph Computing (arXiv:1904.03587v1)
